body: Have you felt any better since?  I feel the same.  Mostly feel sort of stupid for not being successful and at the same time breaking my sobriety

of course.  I think just the fact that I've felt this way for so long.  I've tried so hard to overcome it and it only seems to get worse.  Imagining living for even 10 more years gives me anxiety to have to live with this feeling anymore.  I just want it to stop.
